explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 88 named tracks/releases across the complete Juno Recommends Techno September 2026 chart, related current label windows, adjacent/emerging artists and reissued or overlooked catalogue. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Explicit threat- or panic-coded propositions were deprioritized without creating a blanket intensity or genre ban.
Completed discovery Runs 239, 240, 241, 243 and 244 were compared before ranking. None of the proposed boundaries repeats a musically evaluated boundary from those runs.

Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, target-local discovery/rejection/PARKED history and the global utility ledger. Recent exact, unresolved and evaluated identities were excluded.

Nine honest leads were retained from distinct exact-track descriptions; the two Forest On Stasys tracks are separately described and separately placed. No artist, texture, novelty, genre, placement or role diversity quota is applied.
No proposed placement touches either protected internal handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.
